prompt:
Style: a real photograph, not a painting, not an illustration, not a 3D render, not CGI, not a game screenshot. Documentary landscape photography of a small working harbour, shot on a full-frame digital camera on a tripod with a 35 mm lens at f/8, ISO 400, half-second exposure during the blue hour. Realistic, restrained colour: cool blue-grey dusk light everywhere, a narrow band of soft orange light low at the horizon, warm tungsten-orange light only from the lit cottage window, the lantern and the lighthouse lamp. Natural dynamic range: no HDR look, no oversaturated postcard sunset, no fantasy glow, no lens flare, no bloom halos, no god rays. Real, weathered materials: dark wet granite quay stones, tarred and salt-bleached timber, chipped paint on the boats, rusty iron, seaweed at the waterline. Fine natural sensor grain, slight lens vignetting, sharp focus from the quay to the lighthouse.

Camera and composition (the picture is a fixed game background; single areas will be animated separately later, so keep them clearly separated): the camera stands on the quay about 1.2 metres above the ground, level, looking out across the harbour; the horizon lies slightly above the middle of the frame. A large open sky in the upper part with a few low clouds and a clear gap with the first faint stars. A large calm water surface across the middle with soft vertical reflections of the lights. The iron lantern on its wooden post stands on the quay at about one third of the picture width from the left, in the middle distance, its glass lit by a small warm flame. The cottage at the left edge, its chimney top against open sky. The jetty and the two moored boats in the middle distance, each boat with open water all around it. The lighthouse on its rocky headland at the right, its lamp against open sky. The lower quarter of the picture is an empty, flat stretch of stone quay in the foreground, softly lit by the lantern from the left; keep the centre of this foreground completely empty, a character will stand there later. Leave a margin of sky above the clouds and of quay below so the picture can be cropped to 16:9 without losing anything important.

The lighthouse lamp only as a small glowing spot without any beam, no smoke from the chimney, no birds (all of them are animated separately). The lantern and the window without large glow halos. No people and no animals anywhere.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.

Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.

Style: a real photograph of a real, living European badger wearing a real tailored costume, like an on-set photograph of an animal actor for a live-action film, shot with a full-frame camera and an 85 mm lens at f/5.6. Photorealistic fur with individual coarse guard hairs, real wet nose, small dark glossy eyes, real claws; real materials: felted wool cap, waxed cotton vest with stitched seams and brass buttons, wrinkled linen shirt, chunky hand-knitted red wool scarf, worn brown leather satchel, brown paper parcel with rough string. Not a painting, not an illustration, not a cartoon, not a plush toy, not a 3D render, not CGI, no outlines. The attached image only shows the character design: take over the costume, its colours and the stout body proportions, but nothing of its drawing style, its flat colours or its outlines; the result must look like a photograph of a real animal.

The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.

Pose and layout: exactly one full-body figure, centred, standing calmly upright on its hind legs with both feet flat on the same level, in a slight three-quarter view turned a little towards the left side of the picture, looking at the viewer; both eyes open, mouth closed, the parcel held under one arm, the other arm hanging relaxed. The figure fills about 85 % of the image height, with a small empty margin above the cap and below the feet. The long free end of the red scarf is lifted by a light sea wind and blows out towards the right side of the picture: it hangs in the air beside the body with a clear gap of empty background between the scarf end and the body, and it does not overlap the vest, the arms or the parcel (it will be animated later).

Light (the figure will be composited into a photograph of a harbour at dusk, so the light must match it): low-key blue-hour exposure, not bright studio light. Warm tungsten-orange light from a lantern on the left side of the picture, slightly behind the figure at shoulder height, as a soft warm rim and side light on the left edges of fur, cap, scarf and vest; soft cool blue-grey skylight from above and from the front as fill; the right side of the figure in soft blue shadow with a faint cool rim. The black-and-white stripes of the face and the green, cream and red of the costume stay clearly readable. Sharp focus on the whole figure, no motion blur, no depth-of-field blur on the figure. Natural fur edges with fine hairs, a clean closed silhouette, no glow, mist, sparkles or haze around the figure. Isolated on a fully transparent background, no ground, no cast shadow, no frame.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: portrait 2:3.

Turn the attached photograph into a flat colour-coded segmentation map for an animation tool. Keep the composition, the outlines, the positions and the proportions of the attached image exactly, as if traced on a clear sheet laid on top of it: the same framing, the same horizon height, the same size and place of every object. Replace every area by one flat, pure, fully saturated colour with hard, clean edges: no shading, no texture, no outlines, no gradients, no glow, no halos, no details inside the areas. It is a technical map, not a picture: do not keep any colour of the attached photograph, use only the colour codes below. Colour codes: the whole sky including all clouds and stars, down to the horizon: pure blue #0000FF. All open water of the sea and the harbour, including every reflection on the water: pure cyan #00FFFF. The two small fishing boats including hulls, buoys, the small lamp on the bow and the outboard parts: pure magenta #FF00FF. The lit window of the cottage: pure yellow #FFFF00. The glowing glass of the iron lantern on the wooden post: pure orange #FF8000. The glowing lamp at the top of the lighthouse: pure red #FF0000. The chimney of the cottage: pure green #00FF00. Everything else (land, rocks, the headland, the cottage walls and roof, the lighthouse tower, the quay, the jetty and its posts, the mooring ropes, barrels, crates, the coil of rope, the lantern post): pure black #000000. Use no other colours, and do not add, remove or move any object.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.

Edit the attached photograph of the costumed badger: keep the very same animal, the same costume, the same pose, the same body position, the same scale and framing, the same light (warm lantern light from the left, cool blue dusk light from the right) and the same photographic look. Change only the head: the head is turned about 30 degrees towards the right side of the picture, so the badger looks out to the right, past the viewer, towards the sea; the cap turns with the head; mouth closed, both eyes open. The body, the arms, the parcel, the satchel, the vest, the shirt and the whole scarf including its blowing free end stay exactly as they are, at exactly the same place. A real photograph of a real animal, not a painting, not a cartoon, not a 3D render. Natural fur edges, sharp focus, no motion blur, no glow around the figure. Isolated on a fully transparent background, no ground, no cast shadow, no frame.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: portrait 2:3.
